scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat and meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them to the old chapel, but never at night. Oren haggles the price to two silver; Sela says Saltmere Mine flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, with warm water.

scenes.title: Warm water in the Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The mine breathes warm air that smells of candle wax; the tunnel floods with warm black water and floating hymn-book pages. A page is pencilled "M. Brand", which Teo recognises as his sister Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren guess that harbor-master Maren is in the cult; Oren takes 2 damage from bad air.

scenes.title: Midnight bell at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning; two fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder, and pale congregation-like shapes appear on the chapel floor before vanishing. The party flees.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide, since Mira's hymn book points there. Innkeeper Bram gives them free stew and says harbor-master Maren is a sharp-tongued old friend who lost a brother to the bay. They take a long rest.
